title: werauhia vulcanicola

It belongs to the family of Bromeliaceae, a group of flowering plants characterized by their unique leaf structure and ability to store water. The plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation in the body.
